2100: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
2101: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2102: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
2103: Sit comfortably and bring one foot up to rest on the opposite knee.
Hold the foot with your hand.
Slide your fingers between the toes and gently spread them apart.
Keep the movement slow and easy.
2104: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
2105: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2106: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your chin and tilt the pelvis as you push the floor away.
Round your back up toward the ceiling like a cat.
Hold the rounded position for a few seconds.
Return slowly to the neutral starting position.
2107: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while looking slightly forward.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then return to neutral.
2108: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2109: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2110: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.
2111: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
2112: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides for support.
Push through your heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips back down with control.
2113: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Return to upright and switch sides.
2114: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2115: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
2116: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.
2117: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2118: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2119: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.
2120: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.
2121: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.
2122: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and one arm overhead.
Have your partner stand behind you with a hand on your hip and a hand on your raised arm.
Lean sideways as your partner gently guides the movement.
Tell your partner to stop at a mild pull.
2123: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead while your partner steadies your hips.
Lean away from the raised arm while your partner gently guides your arm.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Come back to upright and switch sides.
2124: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2125: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
2127: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Hold the weight securely between your feet or on your ankles.
Brace your core and raise your knees or legs up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
2130: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your upper body up by contracting the abs.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
2133: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.
2135: Start by lying face down on the floor.
Place your forearms on the ground, with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, with your toes on the ground.
Engage your core and lift your body off the ground, balancing on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2136: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing down.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, press the dumbbells straight up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder height, rotating your wrists back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2137: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.
Rotate your wrists as you lift, so that your palms are facing forward at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2138: Adjust the seat height and position to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance as desired.
Engage your core muscles to maintain stability and proper posture.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your workout.
Gradually decrease the resistance and slow down before coming to a complete stop.
Stretch your legs and cool down after the workout.
2139: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to a comfortable level.
Sit on the ergometer with your back straight and feet on the pedals.
Grasp the handles with your hands and position your arms at a 90-degree angle.
Start pedaling with your hands, pushing and pulling the handles in a controlled motion.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
2140: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.
2141: Adjust the resistance level and incline of the elliptical machine to your desired settings.
Step onto the pedals of the machine and grip the handles lightly.
Begin by pushing down with your feet and pulling the handles towards your body.
Continue this motion, alternating between pushing and pulling, to simulate a walking or running motion.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the intensity and speed of the machine before stepping off.
2142: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable position.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Sit up straight with your feet flat on the footrests.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your triceps and push the handles down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2143: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing down.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly rotate your arms in a circular motion, bringing the dumbbells in front of your body and then overhead.
Continue the circular motion, bringing the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2144: Adjust the seat height and cable handles to a comfortable position.
Sit on the bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip at shoulder height.
Push the handles forward and away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2146: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.
2147: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and a band around your thighs above the knees.
Place your feet flat and push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping the knees pressed out.
2148: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glute at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch legs.
2149: Anchor the band low and loop it around one foot, then get on all fours.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Press the foot with the bent knee up toward the ceiling against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
2150: Lie on your side with a loop band just above your knees and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Open the top knee away from the bottom one like a clam.
Keep your pelvis still and do not roll backward.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
2151: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the hand farther from the anchor.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
2152: Place a band around your feet or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Kick one leg back and up against the band without shifting your hips.
Alternate legs, keeping your hips level throughout.
2153: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Keep your chest up and your core braced.
Sit your hips back and down into a full squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and heels on the floor.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
2154: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Place your feet flat, hip width apart.
Push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly and repeat.
2155: Wrap a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your knees bent.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Push your top knee gently out against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
2157: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and lie on your side with your legs straight.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Raise the top leg against the band without rolling backward.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
2158: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and one knee bent, foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight, in line with your thigh.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
2159: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor and extend that leg.
Drive through the other heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and keep the hips level.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
2161: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it and loop it around one foot.
Stand holding a support, or get on all fours, with your core braced.
Kick one leg back against the band, keeping the knee straight.
Squeeze your glute and avoid arching your lower back.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
2162: Place a loop band around your thighs or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Return it quietly and lift the other knee.
Keep your hips from rocking side to side.
Alternate for the planned time or reps.
2163: Lie face down over a bench or box with a band anchored near your feet.
Hold the bench edge and loop the band around your ankles.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Avoid swinging or arching the lower back.
2164: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
2165: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take 10-15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.
2166: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot off the floor, drawing the knee toward your chest.
Lower it and lift the other foot, keeping your hips level.
Continue alternating at a steady pace, then lower your hips.
2186: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and your feet secured.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2187: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2188: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2189: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands with an overhand grip, and raise it above your head.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Extend your arms and raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2192: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Start walking forward in a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set a resistance and pace you can keep up while breathing steadily.
Slow down for a minute before you step off.
2193: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.
2197: Step onto the belt and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start at a walk and raise the speed gradually to a comfortable jog.
Keep your chest tall and your arms swinging loosely at your sides.
Land softly under your hips and keep your steps quick.
Run for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still breathe steadily.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes to cool down.
2198: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
